findings.issue: Button text contrast is too low for readability.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision may not be able to read the button text.
findings.recommendation: Increase text contrast to at least 4.5:1 against the background.

findings.issue: Cards are spaced too tightly and feel crowded.
findings.user_impact: Users may have trouble scanning the content quickly.
findings.recommendation: Add additional spacing between cards to improve readability.
